title: Security Chief Vázquez Appears Before Congress in Report Review
detail: Citizen Security Secretary Pablo Vázquez Camacho appeared before the CDMX Congress on October 22 as part of the glosa of Brugada's Second Government Report. According to Expansión, he reported a 19% reduction in high-impact crimes under the Brugada administration. Excélsior previewed that he would detail the city's security model to legislators.

media.caption: CDMX reports 19% drop in high-impact crimes
